reviewer_policy: Prefer two independent human reviewers for a future confirmatory study. For this bounded PoC, agent review is allowed only as explicitly provisional evidence; it is not a human gold standard or independent human validation.
blinding: Prepare the evaluation review packet before running either resolver. The packet contains deterministic hash-random contributions plus a category-name-stratified selection derived from the frozen identity catalogue; it contains no method outputs, candidate IRIs, or predicted decisions. Reviewers assess the text without seeing method results.

sampling.limitations: The reviewed set is small and intentionally includes both random contributions and identity-name opportunities. It is not representative of the full debate corpus; report its strata and denominators.

detection_metrics: For reviewed spans only, count exact boundary/category matches against explicit-identity-mention, generic-unresolved-reference, ambiguous-office-or-holder, and out-of-registry-named-entity annotations. Report each label separately as well as combined TP/FP/FN counts; no-in-scope-mention and uncertain cases are not positive spans. Do not extrapolate beyond reviewed contributions.
resolution_metrics: For reviewed explicit named mentions with an existing supported target, align predictions only within the same contribution/category when spans are exact or one span fully contains the other; ambiguous alignments count as misses. Compare accepted target IRIs with the reviewed target and report correct, wrong, ambiguous, out-of-registry, abstained and missed separately. Keep exact-boundary detection metrics independent. Precision uses all accepted resolved links in reviewed contributions (unsupported links count as incorrect); coverage is resolved/eligible reviewed mentions. Uncertain labels and explicit references without a supported target are excluded from target-resolution denominators and reported separately.
incremental_retrieval: Report each frozen question's graph, structured-only, and offline exact-phrase results. A result is incremental only if it is not already returned by the equivalent structured relationship (including :speaker/participation and a source-supported Bill section link). Exact-phrase search is an offline lexical comparator, not a measured Elasticsearch deployment. Report relevant/irrelevant/uncertain reviewed results separately; counts alone are not utility evidence.
provenance_and_safety: Preserve exact source Work, contribution IRI, source hash, source pointer, text hash, code-point offsets and surface form.
Never put complete transcript text in RDF, Git, or durable evaluation reports.
Only validated existing owner or registry IRIs may be resolution targets.
A speaker, participation, Bill section, source role, officeholder, or thematic relation is not itself evidence of a transcript mention.
Generic 'the Minister', 'the Deputy', 'the Bill', and 'the Department' are abstentions unless a unique source-local antecedent is demonstrable.
Record every ambiguity, abstention, out-of-registry case, and method failure; do not tune on evaluation labels.
